newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks up sharply by lunch,banks bought back.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks up sharply by lunch,banks bought back.

text.p: Tokyo stocks were up sharply by the lunch break on Tuesday after buy backs in banks and some blue-chip shares extended the rise which was ignited by the Dow's rebound and gains in Nikkei futures in Chicago overnight, brokers said.
The 225-share Nikkei average jumped 229.62 points or 1.30 percent to 17,922.09. Its June futures added 300 points to reach 17,940.
"Short-covering of sectors which were under selling pressure in recent sessions lifted the indices," said Akihiro Naemura, Okasan Securities general manager.
